verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Khoj retrieving from files and notes the user shares and keeps in sync. That is document retrieval the user supplies, not long-term memory the assistant writes to and recalls on its own. Nothing in the pack documents a memory feature that persists facts about the user across sessions, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant remembers me across sessions — durable long-term memory it can write to and recall from automatically
